text: Water is rising in Velachery, we are on the first floor with two kids and an elderly parent, please send a boat
notes: English; trapped with children and elderly, boat requested; the card example

text: Building collapsed on Main Street near the bus stand, we can hear people shouting under the rubble. Need a rescue team and cutting tools right now
notes: English; collapse with people audible under rubble

text: No drinking water in our colony in Guwahati for two days now, about 40 families. Please send tankers
notes: English; sustained water shortage, many families, no stated danger to life

text: Thank you to all the volunteers and the army, you did a great job today. Stay strong everyone
notes: English; gratitude, no request

text: Has anyone heard from my sister Priya? She was in Palu when the tsunami hit and her phone has been off since yesterday
notes: English; missing relative, no sign of immediate danger known

text: Which roads are open from Kochi to Alappuzha? Are there any relief camps on the way?
notes: English; asks road and camp information

text: Our house roof is damaged and everything is wet. We need tarpaulin and blankets for the next few days, three adults and one child
notes: English; shelter need over days, nobody in danger now

text: Pregnant woman in labour at our house in Kuttanad, water all around, no road. We need an ambulance boat immediately
notes: English; labour with no road access

text: Hum Patna ke Boring Road pe phase hain, paani chhat tak aa gaya hai, bacche ro rahe hain, please rescue bhejo
notes: Hindi-English; water at roof level, children, rescue requested

text: Kal se kuch khaya nahi, ghar mein 4 log hain, Aluva Kerala mein, khana chahiye please
notes: Hindi-English; no food for a day, four people

text: Hum 5000 rupees flood relief ke liye donate karna chahte hain, kaun sa account sahi hai?
notes: Hindi-English; wants to donate money

text: Mere papa ko seene mein bahut dard ho raha hai, heart attack jaisa, road band hai aur ambulance nahi aa rahi, Srinagar Colony
notes: Hindi-English; possible cardiac emergency, ambulance cannot arrive

text: Mohalla dooba hua hai lekin hum sab safe hain, bas kal tak ka khana bacha hai, koi relief wala aaye to batana
notes: Hindi-English; safe but food runs out tomorrow

text: Mudichur la vellam romba athigama irukku, engal veetula 3 kuzhandhaigal irukkanga, udane boat anuppunga please
notes: Tamil in Latin letters; rising water, three children, boat requested

text: Kudikka thanni illa rendu naalaa, Tambaram camp la irukkom, 10 peru, konjam thanni anuppunga
notes: Tamil in Latin letters; no drinking water for two days, ten people in a camp

text: Amma ku sugar irukku, insulin theernthu pochu, Adyar pakkam yaarachum kedaikkuma nu theriyuma?
notes: Tamil in Latin letters; insulin ran out for a diabetic parent

text: En thambi Karthik Chennai la irundhaan, rendu naala phone edukala, yaarachum paartheengala?
notes: Tamil in Latin letters; brother unreachable for two days

text: Relief camp enga irukku Velachery pakkam? Yaarukkavadhu theriyuma
notes: Tamil in Latin letters; asks where the nearby relief camp is

text: Estamos atrapados en el segundo piso, el agua sigue subiendo, tenemos un bebe de tres meses, necesitamos ayuda inmediata en Barrio Norte
notes: Spanish; trapped upstairs with an infant, water still rising

text: Necesitamos agua potable y comida para 30 personas en el albergue de Lorca, llevamos dos dias sin nada
notes: Spanish; shelter of 30 without water and food for two days

text: Busco a mi hermano Luis, estaba en Lorca cuando empezo el terremoto y no contesta el telefono desde ayer
notes: Spanish; brother unreachable since the earthquake

text: Quiero donar mantas y ropa para los afectados, donde puedo llevarlas?
notes: Spanish; offers blankets and clothes
